lines.en: I walk on three legs. Steady enough.

lines.zh: 鞋底在沙上留下一排印。
lines.en: My soles leave a row of prints in the sand.
I come up out of the sea.
Water still clings to my scales.
The surf recedes behind me.

lines.zh: 三只鞋踩过海草，湿透了。
lines.en: Three sneakers cross the seaweed, soaked through.
The sand is soft. I go slowly.
I swing my body forward.
These shoes are new. I treasure them.
Dry land is worse than water.
I look back at the sea.

lines.zh: 我的步伐有种奇怪的节奏。
lines.en: My stride has an odd rhythm.
I am looking for something.
My shoes are full of water.
I hold my mouth open to the current.

lines.zh: 海风把我的味道吹上岸。
lines.en: Sea wind carries my scent inland.
Three legs hold me fine.
I stare at the horizon.

lines.zh: 这是我在陆上的第二天。
lines.en: My second day ashore.
I am thinking of going back in.
The tide is going out.
I kick at wet sand.
Something ship-shaped far off.
I shake my dorsal fin.
You stand out on land.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在岸上张了两下。
lines.en: My gills open twice on land.

lines.zh: 我不介意从浅水走到你这。
lines.en: I do not mind leaving the shallows for you.
Let me judge your weight.
I have two rows of teeth.
You are standing in my shadow.
I dislike you on dry land.

lines.zh: 我的鞋子很贵，你踩脏了。
lines.en: These shoes are costly. You have muddied them.
I retreat into the water.
This leg is unsteady.
I rasp like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我游得比你快，水也不凉。
lines.en: I outswim you, and the water isn't cold.
Do not think I fear you.
Water got into my shoes.
Ouch! My spaghetti!
Hit me? I'm a perfectly legitimate meme.
Is that fish?
You hold it out, so I will take it.
The blood smell excites me.
Your fish is shorter than my teeth.
I am already reaching.
Another one.
Step back while I eat.
It is fresher in the water.
That fish is too small — I will not be polite.
I swallowed it.
I turn; you slide off.
My hide is rougher than the sand.
You hit a fish's body.
I barely felt it.

lines.zh: 我的鱼皮蹭过你的袖子，糙。
lines.en: My shark skin scrapes your sleeve, rough.
Do not touch my shoes.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧腹，像撞湿墙。
lines.en: You hit my flank like a wet wall.
Now we are both wet.
You slipped on kelp.
I prefer my own kind, in the water.
This has nothing to do with dry land.
I open my mouth. Nothing comes out.
Not my season.
I flick my tail.
Not on shore; I must return to the waves.
I walk into the surf.

lines.zh: 我转身往水里走，鞋里灌满沙。
lines.en: I turn toward the water, sand filling my shoes.
I bite it to test it.
I carry it in my mouth.
It sank into the sand.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，不是鱼，丢回岸上。
lines.en: I sniff it, decide it is no fish, and toss it back.
If it drops, I leave it.
The kelp is mine, and the bucket too!

lines.zh: 这玩意儿能换刷怪蛋吗？
lines.en: Can this thing buy me a spawn egg?
I picked it up, so nobody grab it.

lines.zh: 我穿着三只鞋，在水边站。
lines.en: Three shoes on, standing by water.

lines.zh: 我三只鞋在沙上踩出三道印。
lines.en: My three shoes leave three trails in the sand.
I have come out of the water.
This bite will be heavy.

lines.zh: 两排牙对着你，海水从缝里流。
lines.en: Two rows of teeth face you, seawater running through.
Three legs are enough to follow.
You chose the wrong shore.
The more you run, the deeper your feet sink.

lines.zh: 我从浅水一路踩到你面前。
lines.en: I splash from the shallows to stand before you.
I am lowering myself.
The surf pushes me on.

lines.zh: 浪推着我的背，我顺势往前。
lines.en: The waves push my back and I go with them.
No water to hide in.
Wind from the sea.
I duck my head under your club.

lines.zh: 海带和桶，都还在我手里。
lines.en: Kelp and bucket — I still have both.
My teeth are ready.

lines.zh: 我的牙卡进你的木盾，拔不出。
lines.en: My teeth lodge in your wooden shield.
Teeth tear a seam open.
That came with seawater.
I ram your waist.
Retreat to the water and it is over.
I shake my head, still biting.
Blood darkens the sand.
I pull back and line up again.

lines.zh: 海水灌进嘴里，我咬了个空。
lines.en: Seawater floods my mouth; I bite only water.
Do not get up.
My shoes are full of seawater.
This shore is mine today.
I smell dry land.
Three legs on sand.
The sea has drawn back.
I look around.
No fish here.
I turn around, slowly.
Fire bleaches my scales.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，砸进湿沙。
lines.en: I drop into wet sand.

lines.zh: 水让我舒服，可这次太深了。
lines.en: Water comforts me. This is too deep.
The blast throws me back into the surf.
That light tightens my gills.
Hungry, I would bite kelp.

lines.zh: 雷劈到海面，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; I go numb.
No sea here. I will dry out.
